name: Incredible
description: Lets the Incredible desktop app carry out web tasks in your browser on your behalf.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'none'; media-src 'none'; style-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; child-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
